label: Войти
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for войти (to enter, to come in). Perfective compound of идти: future войду/войдёшь, suppletive past вошёл/вошла/вошли, imperative войди.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first person. 'Войду' is the 1sg non-past of perfective войти, used with future meaning. Built on the идти pattern with prefix во-, it marks a completed entrance. 'Через дверь' is через + accusative.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second person. 'Войдёшь' is the 2sg future of войти, with the stressed ё. The prefixed-идти stem keeps -йд- before the ending. 'В зал' is в + accusative.

missions.phrase: Учитель войдёт в класс ровно в девять.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third person. 'Войдёт' is the 3sg future of войти. The imperfective partner входить would describe a habitual entrance, but here one completed event is in view.

missions.phrase: Мы войдём тихо, чтобы не мешать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Войдём' is the 1pl future of войти, end-stressed on the ё. The во- prefix on the идти root signals one finished step inside.

missions.phrase: Отец вошёл в комнату без стука.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suppletive masculine past. 'Вошёл' switches to the irregular -шёл root shared across идти compounds. It marks a male subject and a completed entrance. 'В комнату' is в + accusative.
Strategic focus: Suppletive feminine past. 'Вошла' uses the suppletive -шл- root for a female subject, sharing nothing with the future -йд- stem. Past tense here tracks gender, not person.
Strategic focus: Suppletive plural past. 'Вошли' is the plural past of войти on the irregular -шл- root. 'В аудиторию' uses в + accusative for entering the lecture hall.

missions.phrase: Войди и закрой за собой дверь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Войди' is the informal command from войти, built on the -йд- stem plus -и. It tells someone to come in. The imperfective входить gives the habitual counterpart.
Strategic focus: Plural or polite imperative. 'Войдите' is the formal command of войти, adding -те to the singular stem. It is the standard polite 'come in' in response to a knock.

Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Войти' is the bare infinitive, here introduced by 'чтобы' to express purpose. It names the act of entering; 'нужен пропуск' states the requirement. The imperfective infinitive would be входить.
